items.docs: Lists all of your appointments, sorted by most recently created

Creates an Appointment for a sample collection visit. You must provide either an `order_id` or a `user_id`, but not both. When using `user_id`, you must also provide an address (either `address_id` or inline `address`). A `remote` provider type means a practitioner visits the patient at their home or office (i.e. not at a clinic). The collection methods supported depend on the provider — for example, `remote-appt-a` currently supports venous collection only.
